caption: The drawing shows a single, ornate stone sculpture placed on top of a weathered, rectangular stone pedestal. The sculpture consists of three main sections: at the bottom, a wide, rounded base decorated with an egg-and-dart motif and oval elements in relief; above it sits a fluted, bowl-shaped form with a slightly wider rim; and at the top is a small, spherical finial with a vertical rod or spike protruding upward. The overall color palette features earthy tones, predominantly mossy and dark greens with some brown and ochre highlights, giving the appearance of age and patina. The pedestal is depicted in light tan and gray shades, with vertical streaks suggesting texture and weathering. The background is plain off-white, and there are small brownish spots scattered over the paper. The artist's name, "Raymond L. Noble," is printed below the image, along with handwritten notations on the lower right.
title: Stone Fountain
